<subject>Northstar Wireless for Years 2024/2025</subject>
<body>
Since Shirley and I are planning to be at Westbridge tomorrow, we are providing you our list of year-end network revenue items for discussion at your meeting tomorrow.

FYI, if we have more items than you need in total, the items I would prefer to pull back first would be the Northlink interconnect payment, the CRTC compliance fees, and the capitalization of specialized infrastructure costs.

Please let us know how you wish to proceed.
</body>
